blind.description: A set of straight stone masonry stairs ascending to a high landing. The flight consists of ten rectangular stone block steps resting on solid ashlar dressed-stone sidewalls. Beneath the higher section of the staircase is an arched passage or alcove opening with a keystone and curved masonry surround, which cuts through under the stairs (open on one side and recessed on the other). The textures depict weathered, dressed limestone/sandstone blocks with subtle greenish moss or mortar wear between the stones. All surfaces are solid, cleanly modeled, and free of floating or broken geometry.
blind.from_above: A rectangular plan showing a linear flight of ten tiered rectangular stone treads leading up to a wider top landing, oriented vertically in the frame.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.1 times the height of the figure (around 6 to 6.5 ft tall at the top step) and about 1.5 times as long as the figure is tall (around 8.5 to 9 ft long).
